subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report & minimal evidence snapshot
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-corp.com>, procurements@acme-corp.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report & minimal evidence snapshot

Hi Lena / Acme procurement team,

Thanks for the heads up — per our procurement checklist, we can provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a compact evidence snapshot to help accelerate your review. To keep this low-friction, attached are: a one-page summary (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf) and an evidence manifest (evidence_manifest.csv) that maps common SIG/CAIQ asks to where the artifacts live.

Quick asks from your side so we can respond accurately:
- Confirm whether you need the full Type II PDF or a redacted/summary bundle first.
- Confirm the audit period you require (we typically share coverage windows in YYYY-MM-DD).
- Let us know if you require a bridge letter when the audit window does not fully overlap your procurement period.

Options for transfer (pick one):
1) Secure Drive share (we will add listed contacts).
2) Pre-signed S3 link (expires in 7 days).
3) Secure upload to your SFTP (we can push).

Mini templates below you can reuse for internal routing:
- One-line approval to accept summary: "Approved to accept Redwood SOC2 summary + manifest; request full report if issues found."
- If you need a bridge letter: "Please provide a bridge letter covering controls from <start> to <end> or confirm overlap."

Ben (security) is on copy and will be the evidence owner for any follow-ups. If it helps, we can also generate a short bridge-letter draft for signature — attached a template.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0118

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, evidence_manifest.csv
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-corp.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-09-11T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report & minimal evidence snapshot

Hi Neha — thanks, this is helpful. A couple of clarifying items before we route to InfoSec and Procurement: 

1) Audit period: can you confirm the audit period covered by the Type II report (start/end)? Procurement typically wants the period that includes at least the last six months.
2) Scope: does the report include the hosted inference service and our expected data processing flows (API ingestion, temporary KV cache, transit encryption)?
3) Bridge letter: if the report period finishes before our contract start, will Redwood provide a bridge letter or supplemental attestation?

Also, our InfoSec team sometimes requests a SIG Baseline or CAIQ as a quick control map — can you confirm whether you have a SIG export or prefer the manifest you attached?

If you can respond today with the audit window and scope confirmation, we’ll fast-track.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Security Review Lead — Acme Corp
lena.ortiz@acme-corp.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-corp.com>, procurements@acme-corp.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report & minimal evidence snapshot

Hi Lena — quick answers below, and sorry for the dense e-mail; want to make sure your team has what they need.

- Audit period: 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30 (Type II coverage).
- Scope: In-scope systems are our hosted inference API endpoints, customer metadata routing (no long-term storage of uploaded content), network encryption in transit, and related authentication/authorization controls. The summary PDF includes the scope statement; the manifest maps to specific control families.
- Bridge letter: Yes — we can provide a short bridge letter if your procurement window falls outside the audit period. I attached a bridge_letter_template.docx with two options: (A) control coverage affirmation for the audit window above; (B) interim controls confirmation signed by our VP of Security. If you prefer, we can send a pre-signed PDF for signature.
- SIG/CAIQ: We do not publish a full SIG export by default, but the attached manifest is a lightweight mapping. If your team insists on a SIG baseline, Ben can run an export and we can share a sanitized CAIQ-style XLS.

Secure transfer: we recommend Drive share for initial summary + manifest and pre-signed S3 for the full Type II PDF (we can gate by email address). Let us know which contact to add and Ben will act as the point-of-contact for any controls questions.

One-line templates (feel free to copy into procurement thread):
- Accept summary: "Security: accept Redwood SOC2 summary and manifest for initial review; request full report if open questions remain."
- Request bridge: "Security: please provide Redwood bridge letter covering controls through contract start date (see attached template)."

Ben — can you confirm availability to run the SIG export if Acme asks?

Thanks,
Neha

Cc: procurements@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-09-11T12:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report & minimal evidence snapshot

Neha — noted, thank you. A couple of additional practical asks from procurement: 

1) Can you provide an estimated delivery date for the full Type II PDF (if we request it)?
2) If you provide a bridge letter, procurement prefers a signed PDF and a short scope sentence we can include in the contract.
3) Redaction: do you accept redaction requests for sensitive operational details (we can flag items), and what is your turnaround?

If possible, can you share the manifest as a CSV in the Drive folder and add procurements@acme-corp.com to the share? That will let us confirm quickly.

Thanks — if you can send ETA and confirm redaction policy, we’ll route to legal and aim to respond same day.

Best,
Lena
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-corp.com>, procurements@acme-corp.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report & minimal evidence snapshot

Lena — thanks. Quick commitments so your team can plan: 

- ETA for full Type II PDF (if requested): within 2 business days after we receive the secure transfer preference from you (pre-signed S3 or Drive add).
- Bridge letter: we will provide a signed PDF bridge letter (option B from the attached template) and a one-sentence scope clause you can paste into contracts: "Redwood Inference attests that the controls described in the referenced SOC 2 Type II report were operating effectively during the audit period 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30 and apply to the hosted inference service used by Acme Corp."
- Redaction policy: we accept targeted redaction requests for operational details (IP addresses, internal hostnames). Turnaround is typically 1 business day for small requests and up to 3 business days for comprehensive redaction.

I have created a Drive folder and added procurements@acme-corp.com and lena.ortiz@acme-corp.com; the manifest CSV and summary PDF are already in the folder (link: https://drive.redwood.com/soc2/acme-intake-2026). For the full Type II PDF we will share a pre-signed S3 link once you confirm who should receive it.

Next steps (suggested):
1) Procurement confirms Drive share is OK for initial review.
2) If InfoSec wants the full PDF, reply with preferred transfer method and we’ll issue the pre-signed link.
3) If a bridge letter is required, we will email the signed PDF to your legal contact.

Ben — can you standby for potential SIG export; I’ll ask only if they require it.

Thanks and happy to jump on a 15-min call if that moves things faster.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
